en_us: A faction village that falls to a raid loses experience and a part of its stocks. The players who help the village during the raid get reputation with its faction, more when the village holds.
fr_fr: Un village de faction qui tombe face à un raid perd de l'expérience et une partie de ses stocks. Les joueurs qui aident le village pendant le raid gagnent de la réputation auprès de sa faction, plus quand le village résiste.
